clue.text: Punishment for being shifty!

definitions.meaning: a beating given with a thin flexible stick or cane
changing position or direction, moving about from one thing to another

explanation.surface: An exclamation that a shifty character deserves a beating.
explanation.definitionFit: A switch is a cane used for beatings, and to switch is also to change about, as a shifty person does.

clue.text: The guard fight, then retreat

parts.note: a war is a fight on a grand scale
a den is a private retreat or hideaway

explanation.surface: A guard who fights and then falls back.
explanation.definitionFit: A warden is a keeper or custodian, someone posted to watch over a place.

clue.text: Suites may be made from such flimsy material!

indicators.note: these letters can be rearranged to make something else, so the word Suites is reworked

explanation.surface: A remark that hotel suites are built from paper-thin stuff.
explanation.walkthrough: 'may be made from' tells you to rearrange SUITES; 'such' ties the definition back to the clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Tissue is fine thin paper or fabric, a byword for something delicate.

clue.text: Name for a girl's boyfriend

parts.note: her is the possessive for a girl
a woman's man is her boyfriend

explanation.surface: Suggesting a name for some girl's boyfriend.
explanation.definitionFit: Herman is a man's first name.

clue.text: Unnecessary loss of a point is irritating

indicators.note: losing something means it is dropped from the word before it

parts.note: needless means unnecessary
S is south, a point of the compass

explanation.surface: Giving away a point for no reason is annoying, as in a sports match.
explanation.definitionFit: To needle someone is to provoke or annoy them, so 'is irritating' fits the verb form.

clue.text: Prepared by the vegan for a special occasion?

definitions.text: Prepared by the vegan for a special occasion?

parts.words: Prepared by the vegan for a special occasion?
parts.note: read literally, a vegan would lay on a celebratory spread of pulses; the real sense is a jolly party

explanation.surface: Wondering what a vegan would cook for a celebration.
explanation.walkthrough: A beanfeast is British slang for a festive meal or party; taken literally it is a feast of beans, just what a vegan might serve.
explanation.definitionFit: A beano or celebration meal, originally an annual dinner given by employers to workers.

clue.text: On the side, though not yet a member of the team

parts.note: something that happens later has not happened yet
an ally is a partner on one's side, one of the team

explanation.surface: A player on the sidelines who hasn't yet been picked for the side.
explanation.definitionFit: Laterally means sideways or towards one flank.

clue.text: Judgments involving a number in awful scenes

indicators.note: one thing involving another takes it inside it
awful suggests the letters of scenes are in a terrible mess

parts.note: ten is a number

explanation.surface: Court rulings handed down amid dreadful scenes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'awful' turns SCENES into SENCES, and 'involving' puts TEN inside it after SEN.
explanation.definitionFit: A sentence is a court's judgment fixing a punishment.

clue.text: People mature in a commune

parts.note: men are people
to age is to mature

explanation.surface: Grown-ups living together in a collective.
explanation.definitionFit: A ménage is a household, a group living together under one roof.

clue.text: Maintains small-page books are what's wanted

parts.note: P is the small abbreviation for page
to book a table is to reserve it

explanation.surface: Someone insists that small pocket-sized books are in demand.
explanation.definitionFit: To preserve is to keep something going in its present state.

clue.text: Plan a holiday under canvas?

definitions.meaning: on a camping trip you sleep inside canvas, split into two words

explanation.surface: Thinking of planning a camping trip.
explanation.definitionFit: Intent is a purpose or design, and split it reads as being inside a canvas shelter.

clue.text: About to set expert in high favour

parts.note: re means about or concerning
to put is to set
able means skilled or expert

explanation.surface: An expert about to become popular.
explanation.definitionFit: A reputable person is well thought of and respected.

clue.text: There's many a Greek character inside-put behind bars

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral 500, a large number
eta is a letter of the Greek alphabet
in means inside

explanation.surface: A Greek who keeps getting locked up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'many' for D uses the Roman numeral for 500.
explanation.definitionFit: To detain is to hold someone in custody, to lock them up.

clue.text: A sister getting upset over 31

indicators.note: upset tells you to knock the letters of sister over into a new order

parts.note: on can mean over, as in a lid on a box

explanation.surface: A nun is upset over an account.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' turns SISTER into SSERTI; the definition is the answer to 31 across, STATEMENT.
explanation.definitionFit: An assertion is a firm claim, a declared account of something.

clue.text: Say Daphne is always colourful

parts.note: ever means always
green is a colour

explanation.surface: A friend called Daphne is always bright and lively.
explanation.walkthrough: Daphne looks like a woman's name, but it is a shrub that keeps its leaves all year; 'Say' marks it as an example.
explanation.definitionFit: Daphne is a plant whose leaves stay on through winter.

clue.text: A top man not backing up the American university

parts.note: a prince is a top man, a ruler

indicators.note: in a down clue going back up means the word not is read in reverse

explanation.surface: A leading figure refuses to support an American college.
explanation.definitionFit: Princeton is an Ivy League university in New Jersey.

clue.text: Heartless fool joining quiet crawler

indicators.note: the heart, the middle letter, is taken away from the word for fool

parts.note: an ass is a fool
P is piano, quiet in music

explanation.surface: A silly person joins a quiet creep.
explanation.definitionFit: An asp is a snake, a creature that crawls.

clue.text: Taking a couple of trainees, no more

parts.note: L stands for learner, as on a learner driver's plate, so two give LL

explanation.surface: Taking on two trainees and no more.
explanation.walkthrough: L is a learner, from the L-plates on British learner drivers' cars.
explanation.definitionFit: Saying 'that's all' means there is nothing more.

clue.text: Parking transport, explore

parts.note: P is the abbreviation for parking on road signs
RY is railway, a means of transport

explanation.surface: Parking the car, then going off to look around.
explanation.definitionFit: To pry is to poke about, investigating where one perhaps should not.

clue.text: Possibly leaves outside right a few

indicators.note: the rearranged letters sit outside, around, the letter for right
possibly signals the letters of leaves could be put another way

explanation.surface: Perhaps a few leaves lie outside on the right.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Possibly' turns LEAVES into SEVEAL, and 'outside' wraps it around R.
explanation.definitionFit: Several means more than two but not many.

clue.text: Determine to work out

definitions.meaning: to find the answer to a problem

explanation.surface: Being determined to sort something out.
explanation.definitionFit: To resolve is both to decide on a course and to settle or solve a difficulty.

clue.text: In general a young person's place

indicators.note: in tells you the answer sits inside the following run of words

explanation.surface: Where a young person normally lives.
explanation.definitionFit: To lay something is to put or set it down.

clue.text: Worker having to accept a far from reasonable rise

annotationWithheld.clue: Worker having to accept a far from reasonable rise

clue.text: Hesitate to phone, though that's doing wrong

parts.note: er is the sound of someone hesitating
to ring is to phone

explanation.surface: Dithering about making a call, which is a mistake.
explanation.definitionFit: To err is to make a mistake, so erring is going astray.

clue.text: Not on the level like the Continental conservationist body

parts.note: as means like
la is the French word for the
NT is the National Trust, a British heritage and conservation charity

explanation.surface: A European conservation group is accused of being crooked.
explanation.walkthrough: The National Trust looks after historic houses and countryside in Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: Something aslant is tilted, sloping rather than flat.

clue.text: Feeble but well-liked set

parts.note: to be in is to be popular or fashionable
firm means set or solid

explanation.surface: Someone weak yet popular and settled.
explanation.definitionFit: Infirm means physically weak, especially through age.

clue.text: Note: go for profit

parts.note: re is a note of the sol-fa scale
a turn is a go, as in a game

explanation.surface: A memo telling someone to chase money.
explanation.definitionFit: A return is the yield or gain on an investment.

clue.text: He's driven to proceed with green' conversion

parts.note: to pass is to go on or proceed

indicators.note: conversion means the letters of green are changed into another form

explanation.surface: An eco-campaigner urges people to go green.
explanation.definitionFit: A passenger is someone carried in a vehicle rather than at the wheel.

clue.text: Artist at the lathe

definitions.meaning: J M W ..., the English landscape painter
a craftsman who shapes wood or metal on a spinning machine

explanation.surface: A painter working at a lathe.
explanation.definitionFit: Turner was a great English painter, and a turner is one who works a lathe.

clue.text: Bill's without financial commitment following slump-so wise

indicators.note: following means this group of letters comes after the word for slump

parts.note: to sag is to slump

indicators.note: without here means outside, so one piece surrounds the other

parts.note: AC is an account or bill, with the possessive S
an IOU is a written promise to pay a debt

explanation.surface: After a downturn, an account free of debt seems a prudent move.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' in its old sense of outside puts AC'S around IOU.
explanation.definitionFit: Sagacious means shrewd and showing good judgment.

clue.text: Animal with firm back bearing a great deal

indicators.note: back means the abbreviation for firm is read in reverse

parts.note: Co is short for company, a firm
E is east, a compass bearing
a lot means a great deal

explanation.surface: A company's mascot creature carries a lot of weight.
explanation.definitionFit: An ocelot is a wild cat of the Americas.

clue.text: Account presented for amending testament

indicators.note: amending means altering the letters of testament into a new order

explanation.surface: A revised will being offered as a record.
explanation.definitionFit: A statement is a written or spoken account of facts.
